episodes.name: The Road to Kingdom
episodes.overview: An Italian gangster, a royal sheikh and a cash-hungry lord join Eddie for a shooting party. With his eyes on a peerage, he needs it to go off with a bang.

episodes.name: There's a Rat in the Kitchen
episodes.overview: Eddie makes a deal with the Mafia in Milan, while Jack preps for a high-stakes night on the town. But will either be able to deliver on their promise?

episodes.name: Do You Reject Satan?
episodes.overview: The cost of restoring the Halstead estate to its former glory continues to spiral — while the farm staff's demand for more pay comes at an impossible price.

episodes.name: The Bigger Picture
episodes.overview: The House of Lords is split down the middle, so Eddie looks to the church for help. But to get the bishops on side, he needs to ruffle a few feathers.

episodes.name: A Suburban A-Road on the Outskirts of Basingstoke
episodes.overview: Eddie faces the violent consequences of his betrayal — and the cost of his loan. Susie and Joe head to Peru to expand the business behind Bobby's back.

episodes.name: The Bells of San Domenico
episodes.overview: Marco and Eddie mix business with pleasure amid preparations for the big day. As one guest causes trouble, will the event end in a wedding — or a funeral?

episodes.name: This Mad Circus
episodes.overview: When Halstead Manor gets overrun with vermin, it's up to Geoff to stamp them out and save his employers. Susie accuses Bobby of tinkering with the plane.

episodes.name: Bring Me the Head
episodes.overview: A furious Eddie plots his revenge — until Susie steps in. As the truth behind the break-in comes to light, the Horniman family is shaken to its core.

name: Season 2
overview: It's been one year since Eddie and Susie joined forces to work together in Bobby's criminal empire overseas. As they drive to expand their enterprise, the decisions Bobby is making seem to be increasingly unsound. Now Eddie and Susie must decide whether to take action or risk losing it all, but unfettered ambition never ends well...
